description: This file contains benchmark code for the 'hgemm' (half-precision general matrix multiply) operations in QNNPACK, including class definitions, setup routines, and benchmark registration for different hardware configurations.

classes.name: HGEMM
classes.description: Benchmark fixture class for half-precision GEMM operations, managing data buffers and setup/teardown routines.

classes.name: HGEMM_L1
classes.description: Derived class optimizing GEMM for L1 cache size.

classes.name: HGEMM_Op
classes.description: Parameterized GEMM operation class for benchmarking with specific matrix sizes.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes matrices and buffers with random data, prepares packed weights for GEMM.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up data buffers after benchmarking.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns pointer to matrix A data.

methods.name: k
methods.description: Returns pointer to matrix K data.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns pointer to matrix B data.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Returns pointer to packed weight matrix.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Returns pointer to output matrix C.

methods.name: ncStride
methods.description: Returns padded stride for N dimension.

methods.name: kcStride
methods.description: Returns padded stride for K dimension.

methods.name: clampingParams
methods.description: Returns pointer to FP16 clamping parameters.
